facts: The police-officer making an investigation under this Chapter
Any police-officer not below such rank as the State Government may, by general or special order, prescribe in this behalf, acting on the requisition of such officer
Such person shall be bound to answer all questions relating to such case put to him by such officer
holding: A person supposed to be acquainted with the facts and circumstances of the case shall be bound to answer all questions relating to such case put to him by a police-officer, other than questions the answers to which would have a tendency to expose him to a criminal charge or to a penalty or forfeiture.
